title.rendered: Summer Office Hours + Other Need to know information

content.rendered:
Our school office will close for summer break beginning Thursday, June 19th and reopen on Monday, August 11, 2025. Our office hours will be Monday-Friday 7:30 am – 3:30 pm.

During the summer break if you need assistance with anything please call our district office at 503-825-5000. Or you can visit their office at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd. in Sherwood. Their summer office hours are Monday-Thursday 7:30-4:00.

If you would like to register a new incoming student please follow this LINK to our onlne regsitration information. You may also contact the district office at 503-825-5000 for assistance with this process.

Following are the supply lists for the upcoming 2025-2026 school year:

​Supply List – English

Lista de Utiles Escolares – Espanol

For those families with incoming kindergarten students, information about our new kindergarten orientation day, and ramp up week, can be found linked here.
